entries.title: Deuteronomy 21:1
segments: If [one] is found dead in the land which the LORD your God gives you to possess it, lying in the field, and it is not known who has killed him,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 21:2
segments: then your elders and your judges shall come forth. And they shall measure to the cities which [are] around him who is dead.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 21:3
segments: And it shall be, the city nearest to the slain one, even the elders of that city shall take a heifer which has not been worked with, which has not drawn in the yoke.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 21:4
segments: And the elders of that city shall bring down the heifer to an ever-flowing stream, which is neither plowed nor sown, and shall strike off the heifer's neck there in the stream.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 21:5
segments: And the priests, the sons of Levi, shall come near. For the LORD your God has chosen them to minister to him, and to bless in the name of the LORD, and by their word shall every controversy and every stroke be [tried].

entries.title: Deuteronomy 21:6
segments: And all the elders of that city nearest to the slain one, shall wash their hands over the heifer that has been beheaded in the stream.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 21:7
segments: And they shall answer and say, Our hands have not shed this blood, neither have our eyes seen.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 21:8
segments: Be merciful, O LORD, to Your people Israel, whom You have redeemed, and do not lay innocent blood to the charge of Your people Israel. And the blood shall be forgiven them.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 21:9
segments: So you shall put away innocent blood from among you, when you do the right in the sight of the LORD.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 21:10
segments: When you go forth to war against your enemies, and the LORD your God has delivered them into your hands and you have taken them captive,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 21:11
segments: and see among the captives a beautiful woman, and have a desire to her, that you would take [her] for your wife,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 21:12
segments: then you shall bring her home to your house. And she shall shave her head and dress her nails.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 21:13
segments: And she shall put off the clothing of her captivity, and shall remain in your house, and shall sorrow for her father and her mother a full month. And after that you shall go in to her and be her husband, and she shall be your wife.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 21:14
segments: And it shall be, if you have no delight in her, then you shall let her go where she will. But you shall not sell her at all for silver, you shall not make a slave of her, because you have humbled her.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 21:15
segments: If a man has two wives, one beloved and another hated, and they have borne him sons, the beloved and the hated; and [if] the first-born son was of her that was hated,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 21:16
segments: then it shall be in the day when he makes his sons to inherit what he has, he may not cause to [inherit] the son of the beloved first-born before the son of the hated one, he who [is truly] the first-born.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 21:17
segments: But he shall acknowledge the son of the hated as the first-born by giving him a double portion of all that he has. For he [is] the beginning of his strength. The right of the first-born is his.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 21:18
segments: If a man has a son who is stubborn and rebels, who will not obey his fathers voice or his mothers voice, even when they have chastened him [he] will not listen to them,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 21:19
segments: then his father and his mother shall lay hold on him and bring him out to the elders of his city, and to the gate of his place.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 21:20
segments: And they shall say to the elders of his city, this son of ours [is] stubborn and rebellious. He will not obey our voice. [He is] a glutton and a drunkard.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 21:21
segments: And all the men of his city shall stone him with stones so that he dies. So shall you put evil away from you, and all Israel shall hear and fear.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 21:22
segments: And if a man has committed a sin worthy of death, and if he is put to death and you hang him on a tree,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 21:23
segments: his body shall not remain all night on the tree. But you shall surely bury him that day (for he that [is] hanged is accursed of God), so that your land may not be defiled, which the LORD your God gives you [for] an inheritance.
